blurb: Colorado Creations by Glenbrook Gallery, located in Empire, Colorado, specializes in custom wood carvings by artist Daryl Boone. Known for his intricate, one-of-a-kind Santa carvings, Daryl crafts pieces that appeal to Christmas collectors, sports enthusiasts, and anyone who loves unique Santa-themed décor.
